As a Staff Engineer, you'll be the technical anchor for GitLab's Nonlinear Productivity team in the US: the person who decides what "proven" means before something ships, and who helps shape what the team builds next, not just how to build it. It's a from-scratch, generalist team with no dedicated product manager — that ownership starts on day one.

s.h: Some examples of the problems this team takes on
s.t:
Cutting the time it takes to complete a good code review — one that still keeps a human in the loop — by half, using agentic solutions.
Turning a manual, error-prone release step into an agentic workflow that catches its own mistakes before a human ever has to.

Set the technical direction for the team's agentic systems, from how agents are orchestrated to where a step should stay human-owned, and defend those calls once they're tested against real code.
Discover and prioritize sources of friction across GitLab's SDLC, driving the fix — agentic, process-based, or both — from a rough hypothesis through to a shipped, measured result.
Work across any part of GitLab's codebase as the problem requires, since this team operates like a small, generalist group rather than one scoped to a single service.
Apply distributed systems judgment to catch cases where generated code looks correct but breaks under concurrency, at scale, or across deployment topologies (including self-managed, dedicated, and multi-tenant environments), and coach others to do the same.
Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on agent engineering practices and distributed systems judgment, through design reviews and pairing that raise the team's collective bar rather than just your own output.
Collaborate with the India-based group a few times a week to align on the roadmap, and represent the team's technical progress to stakeholders in the Chief Technology Officer's organization.
Serve as a bar raiser for the team's hiring, owning the Technical Leadership round for other Staff-level candidates as the team scales.
Own a greenfield technical foundation from day one, with your scope and impact free to grow as the team scales.

Experience building reliable agentic or large language model (LLM)-based systems, including multi-step orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and recovery.
Ability to work autonomously in unfamiliar codebases and drive solutions from discovery through completion.
Strong distributed systems and computer science fundamentals, including coordination, consistency, idempotency, rate limiting, failure modes, and degradation under load.
Proficiency in Go, Rust, or Python, with the ability to read and modify code in the others.
A track record of delivering results from unclear or incomplete requirements — able to take a complex, loosely specified problem and decompose it into a concrete proposal of small, shippable steps.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for systems where "looks plausible" and "is actually correct" are different questions, and a track record of raising the quality bar for a team's output, not just your own.
A history of unblocking and enabling teammates — through design reviews, technical writing, or mentoring — and of engaging regularly with other teams to find where collaboration actually pays off.

Nonlinear Productivity — shortened internally to "NLP," with no relation to natural language processing — is one of GitLab's newest teams: a strategic incubation group that reports into AI Platform leadership under the direct sponsorship of the CTO.

It's split into a US group (this role) and an India-based group working the same charter; the two sync on roadmap and tooling a few times a week but otherwise run day to day on their own. Solutions that prove out internally are the team's path to a monetized, customer-facing GitLab offering.
It's a good fit for engineers who want technical ownership of something with no existing playbook, and a hand in defining a brand-new part of GitLab from its first commit.

Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.
Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.
Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.
Woran du arbeiten wirst
Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren.

Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.
Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?
Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?
Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.
LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.
Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry; we are committed to turning the world from combustion to electric. We design, build, and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus, and engineering excellence.

We value diversity of thought, background, and approaches, and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!
To reach our goal, we are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Backend Team. At Qwello, you will architect, design, and implement new backend services (typically in Rust and Python) to support our growing fleet of self-designed/built charging stations being deployed across Europe.

You will also design and implement backend-to-backend systems connecting the Qwello systems with the services of Qwello's partners. Reliability and craftsmanship are important to you, so you design with automatic testability, resilience, introspection & observability in mind. Security is important to you.

You are an efficient engineer, focused on the fast execution of your craft. You are a good communicator, a free thinker, have an inquisitive mindset, and an eye for detail. You enjoy sharing your knowledge with your colleagues and mentoring junior team members.

You are comfortable working in a startup, collaborating in an interdisciplinary team, and willing to contribute, with your skills, experience, and enthusiasm, to help us build a successful business. As a proactive and committed team member, we continuously motivate you to continue learning and developing your skills.
Let's power the future together! ⚡

Design and implement new backend services and serverless code in Rust and Python
Drive the transformation of our system architecture to meet our business needs and scale to our goals
Take part in strategic and execution planning, code reviews, design reviews, and hiring
Maintain and improve the Qwello backend as part of the backend team
Work in close collaboration with our partners to integrate our services with theirs
Take ownership, along with the rest of the team, for building and refining our service as the business expands
Your Profile ✨
Proven experience as a Software Engineer implementing complex, larger projects
Expert-level Python implementation skills
Experience with Rust as a development language would be a big plus; the willingness to learn it is a must
Solid experience with architecting & implementing distributed systems
Hands-on off-premise cloud experience, preferably AWS, but Azure, Google Cloud, or similar via laC (Terraform) is also great
A make-it-happen attitude, helping the team to deliver on changing the world from combustion to electric
Ability to self-organize and lead in an environment of changing priorities; willingness to work on multiple tasks/content switching
Fluency in English; German language knowledge is a nice-to-have

Flat hierarchies with an efficient decision-making processes without red tape
The opportunity to play a key role in shaping the mobility revolution
Be a part of an international dynamic team of more than 30 nationalities

Regular company and team events outside of the office to disconnect from our computers and reconnect with colleagues on hikes, mountain e-bike tours, off-sites, and more

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.
Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive
The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits , there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.
The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user.

Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits . The frontend is built on React and Vite , leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second.

On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default
Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!
We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !
The Foundation Team
The Foundation team builds what the product teams build on: the shared backend framework, the internal libraries, the common services and abstractions that every Proton application reaches for. If several teams need it, it should exist once, and be good.
You will work in PHP for API related work, and in Rust for components where performance and memory safety justify it or for microservices. You will own libraries or initiatives end to end: design, implementation, documentation, versioning, and the migration path for everyone already depending on the old version.
Architecture is a large part of this role. Many engineers work in the same monorepo, which means module boundaries, dependency direction, and ownership are not academic concerns — they decide whether the codebase stays navigable or slowly turns into something nobody can change safely.

You will help define those boundaries, make the structural calls that keep teams from stepping on each other, and do some work to enforce them: writing the RFC, adding rules, untangling the cycle that shouldn't have been there. None of this happens in isolation. You will work closely with other teams who consume and use what you build.

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

s.h: Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles
s.t:
Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.
In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).
Kalepa ’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

We’re looking for strong backend engineers who love building reliable systems around fragmented, but high-value data. As part of the Core Backend team, you’ll work on the systems at the center of Kalepa : designing services, data models, pipelines, and evaluation loops. The goal is not just cleaner data, but an intelligence layer that makes better, faster, and more explainable decisions.
You’ll join a high-ownership team responsible for some of Kalepa ’s most business-critical infrastructure. Your work will make our data more complete, our decisions more transparent, and our products even more valuable.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Our humble expectations

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.

Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.
Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.
Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.
Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user.

Working on solutions that support millions of users

You'll also be the first R&D engineer based at our US site, hybrid, with your manager and the rest of the team in a different time zone - so you'll need to hold context, make decisions, unblock yourself, and know when a question is worth raising rather than waiting on a sync.

Your closest day-to-day partners will be mobile engineers and product managers
What You'll Be Doing
Own the backend behind growth bets. Build and ship the services powering paywalls, subscription tiering, onboarding journeys, in-app messaging, referral mechanics, trial models, and checkout bundling.
Make growth measurable. Build and extend the experimentation and instrumentation layer - feature flags, experiment assignment, event tracking - so every bet the team makes can be evaluated on real data rather than opinion.
Work end to end across the funnel. Move between acquisition, activation, and retention work as the roadmap demands, rather than owning a single narrow surface.
Partner tightly with mobile and product. Most of what you build is consumed by our iOS and Android apps. You'll design API contracts in conversation with the engineers using them and with the PMs shaping the experiments.
Operate with high agency. Take ambiguous problems, decide on an approach, communicate it clearly in writing, and ship. Escalate deliberately, not by default.
Set the pattern for US engineering at Nanit. How you work - documentation, async communication, on-call, review habits - becomes the template for everyone who follows.
Anchor on-call coverage in your time zone. Be first responder for production alerts during your working hours, extending the backend group toward true follow-the-sun coverage. Triage, mitigate, escalate what you can't, and hand off open threads in writing.
Contribute to the backend guild. Help drive best practices, guidelines, and standards across R&D, and keep the US perspective represented in them.

Proven Autonomy: Demonstrated success working with significant independence - ideally in a distributed team with limited timezone overlap with your manager or peers.

Product Mindset: Comfort with ambiguity and with shipping to learn. You care about the outcome metric, not only the ticket.
High-Scale Systems: Experience with critical production systems and techniques like load balancing, caching, and distributed systems.
Web Services: Proficiency designing and maintaining APIs consumed by mobile clients (REST, gRPC, WebSocket).
Experimentation and Analytics: Hands-on experience with A/B testing infrastructure, feature flags, and event instrumentation (e.g., Unleash, Mixpanel).
Testing: Solid experience in testing methodologies and test automation frameworks.
Monitoring and Observability: Proficient with tools like Grafana and Prometheus.
Delivery Track Record: Proven experience delivering backend projects successfully.
Agile Familiarity: Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
Containers and Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.

Experience with consumer subscription products - billing, plan tiering, App Store and Google Play in-app purchases, or Stripe.

Commitment to well-crafted and rigorously tested code.

Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage risk. There is no playbook yet. You will help write it.
Our stack includes Go, Node.js, Python, React Native, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs over SEPA Instant rails. Experience with any of these is a plus. What matters more is that you pick up new tools fast and care about writing reliable, maintainable code.
Strong Bonus (not required)
If any of the following apply to you, you will hit the ground running faster than most:
You have meaningful hands-on experience building payment systems, fintech infrastructure, or financial APIs.
You have designed a ledger and understand double-entry bookkeeping, immutable transaction records, and why you never update a financial row.
You have solved the partial failure problem. Money left one wallet and did not arrive in the other. You know how to detect it, resolve it, and prevent it.
You understand idempotency at a design level. Your systems survive client retries, duplicate webhooks, and network drops without double-charging anyone.
You have built or reasoned about reconciliation: detecting discrepancies between your internal ledger and an external settlement file and resolving them reliably at scale.
You understand KYC and KYB state machines and what a regulator expects from your audit trail.

Be part of a founding team eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium, a grant from the German government that funds you to build.
Flexible hours and fully remote within Germany.
Early-stage means something here. Small team, real ownership, no queue of 40 PRs ahead of yours.
The problems are genuinely hard. Distributed systems, financial consistency, payment rails, real money moving in real time. If you want to spend your next two years solving problems that actually require you to think, this is the right place.
The systems you build will not be thrown away after a demo. They will run in production, handle real transactions, and be used by real people. Your fingerprints stay on it.
You will work with people who left stable paths to build a faster, simpler way to move money in Germany. Less bureaucracy, more momentum. If that sounds like your kind of problem, you will fit right in.
For the right person who grows with the company, equity is a conversation we will have when the time is right.

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + benefits | Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

We have over 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.
These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.
We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

s.h: We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies
s.t:
Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here )
Cassandra for most persistent data storage
Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
Envoy Proxy for RPC
Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services
AWS for most of our infrastructure
React for internal web dashboards
We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties

This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!
Together you’ll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our product squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are; Money, Borrowing, Fincrime, Customer Operations, Platform, Personal Banking & Business Banking.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need!
Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing
We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework we are also hiring on L40 & L50, our interview process will determine your levelling.

Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry; we are committed to turning the world from combustion to electric. We design, build, and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus, and engineering excellence.

We value diversity of thought, background, and approaches, and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future!
To reach our goal, we are looking for a Backend Developer to join our Backend Team. At Qwello, you will help to design and implement new backend services (typically in Python or Rust) to support our growing fleet of self-designed/built charging stations being deployed across Europe.

You will also work on backend-to-backend systems that connect Qwello’s systems to our partners’ services. Reliability and craftsmanship are important to you, so you aim to design with automatic testability, resilience, introspection, and observability in mind. Security is important to you.

You are an efficient engineer, focused on executing your tasks well and learning quickly. You are a good communicator and a free thinker with an inquisitive mindset and an eye for detail.

You are comfortable working in a startup, collaborating in an interdisciplinary team, and willing to contribute, with your skills, experience, and enthusiasm, to help us build a successful business. As a proactive and committed team member, you’re motivated to continue learning and developing your skills.
Let's power the future together! ⚡

Design and implement new backend services and serverless code in Python and Rust
Drive the transformation of our system architecture to meet our business needs and scale to our goals
Participate in team discussions, code reviews, and planning sessions to learn and contribute
Help maintain and improve the Qwello backend as part of a backend team
Experience first-hand with architecting & implementing distributed systems
Practice hands-on off-premise cloud experience. We use AWS, but experience with Azure, Google Cloud, or similar platforms via laC (Terraform) is also great
Work in close collaboration with our partners to integrate our services with theirs
Play a hands-on role in helping the team enhance our service as we continue to expand

Senior Backend Engineer (Java, SpringBoot) (m/f/d)
Company Description
MF Group is a subsidiary of Riverty and part of the Bertelsmann Group. Around 120 employees work across two locations in Switzerland to make invoice\-based purchasing with flexible installment payments even simpler and safer for Swiss retailers. As a leading Swiss provider, we are a key partner for the retail sector, combining credit checks, fraud prevention, invoicing, and pre\-financing into a comprehensive end‑to‑end solution.
In addition to our straightforward invoice payment solutions—both online and in‑store—we offer private customers flexible cash loans. We also issue a variety of payment cards. Our strength lies in managing complex projects where multiple sales channels and payment methods interact seamlessly. We work with nearly all major brick‑and‑mortar and online retailers in Switzerland, actively shaping the future of payments.
Job Description
To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) to join our team and drive the evolution of our core financial platform. This is a full\-time position with a permanent contract, based in Chiasso.
We build and maintain core financial services that power MF Group products. This includes systems for tracking customer account balances, orchestrating invoice creation and distribution, and ensuring financial data flows accurately across merchants and platforms.
Our current backend stack is built primarily with Java, the ecosystem, and Oracle/MySql databases, supporting established monolithic applications where data consistency, performance, and reliability are critical. At the same time, new solutions are increasingly developed as microservices running on Kubernetes, following event\-driven architecture principles with Kafka.
As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will tackle meaningful technical challenges across ledgers, invoice flows, and digital payment solutions in a dynamic, informal environment. From analysis to testing, you will help shape new features, evolve our architecture, integrate payment systems, and deliver secure, scalable, user\-friendly experiences for merchants and consumers.

Design, build, test, and operate backend services that support payments, invoicing, ledger flows, and financial data consistency.
Help shape the technical direction within your domain, making trade\-offs explicit and aligning them with business impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed.
Help decompose our monolithic financial platform into clearer domain\-oriented services.
Improve system quality through simpler architecture, better observability, cleaner APIs, automated testing, and reduced operational complexity.
Use production data and operational signals to identify risks, propose improvements, and follow them through with the team.
Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers: conduct code reviews, share architectural context, and raise the technical bar of the team.

s.h: What will help you succeed in the role
s.t:
You’re a seasoned software engineer (5\+ years) with experience building enterprise applications with Java and , combined with a solid understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, relational databases, SQL, and data modeling.
You take ownership of your work, constructively challenge assumptions, and translate improvement opportunities into practical, maintainable solutions.
You thrive in collaborative environments, value diverse perspectives, and communicate clearly in Italian and English across disciplines
Experience building scalable, resilient, and highly available backend systems.

You combine a strong quality mindset with a pragmatic approach to reducing complexity in existing systems, using automated testing as a key enabler of reliable software delivery.
Experience decomposing a monolith into bounded, domain\-oriented services.
Experience designing and implementing event\-driven architectures, particularly with Kafka or similar messaging platforms.
Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards.
Hands\-on experience with AI tools for coding, code review, testing, documentation, skills, prompts, instructions, and plugins.
Additional Information

Small engineering teams with visible technical impact.
Short delivery cycles and direct access to production and stakeholders.
A pragmatic agile environment focused on continuous value delivery.
Training and development opportunities through Riverty and Bertelsmann training sessions and customized development plans.
A hybrid work model with home office, which lets you combine on\-site teamwork and remote work to create the professional experience that best suits your life.
Benefit from a comprehensive range of employee benefits and exclusive discounts designed to support your professional and personal well\-being.
Please note that benefits could be different depending on agreement details, and they may change over time. We'd be delighted to explore these benefits in greater depth during an interview.
